scope: offline evidence inventory for S22 and KS-16X update and image-trust boundaries

app_base.s22_evidence: s22-developer-pack/firmware/decrypted/ (bundled app images); older detailed report ../s22-research/README_RU.md is external
app_base.interpretation: available decrypted OTA files map to application; preceding low Flash is not included

categories.finding: OTA file format for examined S22 and KS-16X images is AES-256-CBC, zero IV, whole-file input, no PKCS#7 stripping. KS-XE public flash-dump bootloader implements AES routines; original ARM CBC/AES code matches host decryption for S22 sample and KS-16X images decrypt to valid app vectors, code and descriptor structures.

evidence.detail: 32-byte key in KS-XE dump; functions 0x08001c88 setup, 0x08001cc8 CBC, 0x08001bac receive/decrypt loop per s22-research/README_RU.md
executes ARM Thumb functions 0x08001c88 and 0x08001cc8 and compares 128 decrypted S22 v2.35 bytes
same AES-CBC format and exact reverse encryption for local KS-16X v2.12/v2.20/v2.23 images; image hashes and decrypted hashes recorded in ks16x/SHA256SUMS.txt

categories.limit: The flash dump identifies its own loader banner as KS-XE scooter (CH32F103CP), not S22 or 16X. Matching AES support does not prove that S22 or 16X bootloaders share its policy or accept arbitrary images.

categories.status: affirmative only for S22 BMS subprotocol; main-board update CRC unknown
categories.finding: S22 v2.36 BMS block frame path checks header and payload CRC-16 (poly 0x1021, init 0) before staging writes; these are error checks, not authentication. Main-board updater path has no established CRC result in this evidence slice.

evidence.detail: CRC-16 function; 0x080169cc parses 0x7a/0x31 BMS blocks; validates header [2:18], index/count and payload; calls writer 0x08017764 only after checks
bounded Unicorn execution of S22 v2.36 receiver block, stubbing Flash writer and response queue

categories.limit: This is BMS firmware transfer inside the application and is not evidence about the main-board bootloader protocol.

categories.status: application request confirmed; bootloader interpretation unknown
categories.finding: S22 app dispatch branch writes a service word through 0x08022b48 -> 0x08022d98 at Flash 0x0803a800, then requests MCU reset through AIRCR 0xe000ed0c with SYSRESETREQ. The condition and reset path are present in v2.35/v2.36 app code. Exact marker semantics and bootloader transition after reset are unknown.

evidence.detail: legacy dispatcher gates branch on 0x20003181 == 1 and abs(VehicleSpeed) < 1000; service-word writer precedes reset
S22 image parameter table names RUNOKFLG, APPSIZE, APPCRCCODE, APPCRCCHECK at these Flash addresses
KS-16X app descriptors point to BOOTVERSION value 0x08005308 and app values beginning 0x08008308; RUNOKFLG/APPSIZE/APPCRCCODE/APPCRCCHECK fields are in the app region

categories.limit: Named fields and one app-side marker/reset sequence do not reveal bootloader state machine or acceptance policy.

categories.status: descriptor/additive checks verified for sample images; loader enforcement only partly known
categories.finding: S22 v2.19/v2.31/v2.32/v2.35 and KS-16X v2.12/v2.20/v2.23 descriptor body values match sum of little-endian uint32 words modulo 2^32. APPCRCCHECK matches (APPSIZE + APPCRCCODE + 0x14502367) modulo 2^32. In S22 v2.35 app code at 0x080163b4 checks this relation; it is not a cryptographic signature. S22 v2.33/v2.36/v2.37/v2.41 carry sentinel RUNOKFLG=0x268479df, APPSIZE=0, APPCRCCODE=0x12345678, APPCRCCHECK=0x268479df, so these descriptors do not provide a verifiable body sum.

evidence.detail: reproducible per-image descriptor/body sum extraction with SHA-256 and exact offsets
script documents and verifies the S22 descriptor relation; explicitly states it is not signature verification
source analysis distinguishes BMS CRC and additive checksums from app authenticity

categories.limit: S22 app function verifies descriptor arithmetic in that app build; actual bootloader policy and KS-16X code enforcement have not been established. Successful checksums in shipped images do not demonstrate anti-tamper acceptance behavior.

categories.finding: No affirmative signature-verification key, signature structure or verified signature routine is established by the inspected app descriptor/transport material. No claim of unsigned firmware is made.

evidence.detail: explicitly limits conclusions because S22 bootloader image is absent
AES and CRC evidence expressly do not determine modified-image acceptance

categories.limit: Absence of crypto strings, parsed signatures or a signed trailer in these inputs cannot rule out checks in missing code or an undocumented format.

updater_apps.detail: DeviceUpdateViewModel downloadFirmWare/updateFirmware/startUpdataFirmware uses BleFirmwareUtil, initializes file size/path, sends ConstantBle.updateFirmware() over BleService.writeData(), and registers parseData() response listeners. This excerpt does not establish whether BleFirmwareUtil performs content authentication/checksum.
Current package includes DEX and Flutter libapp.so. No complete updater decompilation audit in this assignment; app-side integrity/signature result unknown.

KS-16X.evidence: ks16x/REPORT_RU.md; decrypted OTA files map to app at 0x08008000

KS-XE comparative fragment.status: present, different product; not transferable as loader policy
KS-XE comparative fragment.file: ../s22-research/evidence/KS-XE-public-flash-dump.bin (external sibling workspace; not bundled; source URL in ../s22-research/sources.json)
KS-XE comparative fragment.known_bootloader_vs_app_boundary: app vectors at file offset 0x2800; bootloader functions around 0x08000000-0x080027ff

reproduction.result: 18 images (15 S22, 3 KS-16X): descriptor relation matches 18/18; body sum matches all 11 nonzero-APPSIZE images; 7 zero-APPSIZE descriptors are not body-summed. Exact corpus and manifest hashes are checked before interpretation.

corpus.validation: Each input SHA-256 is checked against the manifest before descriptor bytes are interpreted; exact filenames/counts are asserted.

provenance.decrypted image lineage: Decryption artifacts are bundled; extraction records their hashes. Method provenance for earlier sample checks is described in the nonbundled ../s22-research workspace.
